note: Conceptual/architecture lesson on denormalization and roll-up summary field mechanics. No screenshots per this course's policy: taught through prose, tables, and a written scenario, never UI click-paths. Verified directly against the official Salesforce Help article on roll-up summary fields: master-detail-only requirement, the supported standard-object cases (Opportunities-with-products, Accounts-with-Opportunities, Campaigns-with-members), the COUNT/SUM/MIN/MAX calculation set with no native AVERAGE, field-type restrictions on filter criteria, the up-to-30-minute recalculation window, and the lock against converting a master-detail relationship to a lookup once a roll-up summary field exists.
